login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: With your e-mail address and password.
login.mfaHint: Confirm the sign-in with your authenticator app, a recovery code or a passkey.
login.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be verified.
login.stepExpired: This sign-in step has expired — start the sign-in again.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.hint: Enter your e-mail address. If an account exists, you will receive a link.
reset.sent: If an account exists for this address, we have sent a reset link. It is valid for one hour.
reset.done: Your password has been set. Every other session was ended — sign in again.
reset.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

invitation.title: Welcome to Nexotec
invitation.hint: Set your password to activate your account.
invitation.invalidLink: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask your business for a new one.
invitation.mfaNext: Your password is set. Sign in now with your second factor.

password.rules: At least 12 characters. Not your name, your e-mail address or the name of your business.
password.minLength: The password must have at least {{count, number}} characters.
password.denyList: The password must not contain your name, your e-mail address or the name of your business.
password.breached: This password appears in a known data breach — choose another one.
password.reused: This password was used recently — choose a new one.

security.enrolmentRequired: Your business requires a second factor. Set up an authenticator app or a passkey before you continue.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.enrolled: Set up — a code is asked for at every sign-in.
totp.step1: 1. Enter this key in your authenticator app (or open the link below on the device).
totp.step2: 2. Enter the code the app shows now.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.saveHint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once; they are not shown again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.label: Label
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.failed: The passkey could not be added.
